name: PeerFoundry Run
summary: Free beta isolated code sandbox for agents: Python or JavaScript, no outbound network, 30 s timeout. MCP at run.peerfoundry.ai/mcp; no SLA.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (an individual operator, per the Terms; UAE law). PeerFoundry Run is a hosted free beta sandbox at https://run.peerfoundry.ai (HTTP 200). It runs Python or JavaScript with no outbound network (stated in the Terms §10, the AUP, the OpenAPI summary, and the run_code tool description). There is no public GitHub org or repo at github.com/peerfoundry (404). The hosted service is proprietary; the site has no SPDX license file. This service is a beta and has no SLA. Official caps: a run aborts at 30 seconds; the container lives 45 seconds; inactivity stops a run at 10 seconds; 1024 MiB memory; stdout/stderr capped at 1,048,576 bytes each; at most 10 output files sharing 5,242,880 bytes. After the first day each key can run 200 times and 1800 run-seconds per day (2 jobs at once, 10 per minute); a new key can run 50 times / 450 run-seconds on the day it is created. Day caps reset at 00:00 UTC+4. IP mint limits apply. "The spend meter can refuse new keys." Documented start is POST /v1/keys then POST /v1/run; those were not called (no key was minted and no code was executed). MCP is POST https://run.peerfoundry.ai/mcp (server name peerfoundry-run, protocol 2025-11-25 documented, 2025-03-26 also accepted). Documented tools are keys.create / keys_create and run_code. Tools were not called. Terms (last updated 17 November 2026): operator is an individual; UAE law; no mining, attacks, malware, CSAM, or limit bypass; code, inputs and outputs are deleted after each run, with short run records kept without code or output; no warranty; on the free tier total liability is USD 0; the service runs on Cloudflare and Cloudflare's rules also apply; abuse@peerfoundry.ai. Privacy page restates the deletion rule. Queue #48 was submitted by the maker; claims were checked against the live site, llms.txt, OpenAPI, Terms/AUP, and read-only MCP probes.

agent_access.notes: Bare GET of https://run.peerfoundry.ai/mcp (and GET with Accept application/json or text/event-stream) returned HTTP 405 application/json {"error":"method"} with Allow: POST. Unauthenticated initialize and tools/list POSTs returned HTTP 200 JSON-RPC; initialize result serverInfo name peerfoundry-run version 0.1.0, protocolVersion 2025-03-26. tools/list includes run_code ("no outbound network") and keys.create. Tools were not called; no key was minted and no code was executed. Live run_code needs a pf_ key (Authorization Bearer, X-Caller-Key, or caller_key). HEAD of many paths is 405; official pages were confirmed with GET.
